info.title: Mortgage applications, loans and denials by county: home purchase and refinance lending from HMDA: data API
info.summary: Static, read-only JSON and CSV files. No key, no sign-up. CORS open.
info.description:
Mortgage applications, loans and denials by county: home purchase and refinance lending from HMDA: How many home-purchase, refinance and cash-out refinance applications lenders reported under the Home Mortgage Disclosure Act in each county, state and the nation, how many became loans (with the dollar amount) and how many were denied, with the denial rate. State and US rows add the year before.

Probative is a marketing firm, not a law firm; not legal advice. Every JSON response starts with a "meta" object holding the credit line, citation, DOI and license (CC BY 4.0).
